Title: Azure Cosmos DB: New pricing option

Body.Content: We are excited to announce a new pricing option for Azure Cosmos DB, offering greater flexibility in optimizing cost and performance. You can use the new pricing option to reserve throughput independently from data storage for a collection. You have the flexibility to incrementally adjust throughput for a collection over time as needed. Throughput is billed on the amount reserved, whereas SSD-backed storage can be billed on the amount consumed. To learn more about Azure Cosmos DB pricing, see Azure Cosmos DB pricing details.
